title: Standard financing agreement — 2026 wording
body:
FINANCING AGREEMENT {{agreementNumber}} (rev. A)

This financing agreement is entered into on {{date}} between {{financierOrgName}} (the Financier) and {{applicantName}} (the Applicant).

1. FACILITY
The Financier extends financing of {{amount}} {{currency}}, repayable over {{tenorMonths}} months ({{rateType}}; rate: {{ratePercent}}).

2. REPAYMENT SCHEDULE
{{installmentSchedule}}

3. OFFER NOTES
{{offerNotes}}

4. GENERAL
The Applicant consents to be bound by the terms of this Agreement and understands the installment schedule and the obligation to pay on time.
